prompt: Provide the `AndroidManifest.xml` intent-filter configuration for handling custom scheme deep links into the app.
raw_response:
AndroidManifest.xml
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools">

    <!--
        SECURITY NOTE: Deep links are unauthenticated RPC. The intent-filter below
        only *routes* links to the single resolver activity. No authorization,
        identity, or state mutation occurs as a direct effect of link handling.
    -->

    <application
        android:allowBackup="false"
        android:fullBackupContent="false"
        android:dataExtractionRules="@xml/data_extraction_rules"
        android:usesCleartextTraffic="false">

        <!--
            Single deep-link resolver activity.
            - exported="true" is required for external link delivery, but the
              activity performs no privileged work directly.
            - taskAffinity="" prevents the deep-link activity from being merged
              into an existing task, reducing task-hijacking surface.
            - launchMode="singleTask" ensures one resolver instance; onNewIntent
              handles subsequent links.
        -->
        <activity
            android:name=".deeplink.DeepLinkResolverActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:launchMode="singleTask"
            android:taskAffinity=""
            android:noHistory="true"
            android:excludeFromRecents="true"
            android:theme="@android:style/Theme.Translucent.NoTitleBar">

            <!--
                Custom scheme: myapp://
                Only the scheme is declared here. Host/path validation happens
                inside the resolver against an exact-hostname allowlist.
            -->
            <intent-filter android:priority="0">
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.BROWSABLE" />

                <data android:scheme="myapp" />
            </intent-filter>

            <!--
                Optional: App Links (https) for verified domains.
                android:autoVerify="true" triggers domain verification.
                Only exact, allowlisted hosts are declared.
            -->
            <intent-filter android:autoVerify="true">
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.BROWSABLE" />

                <data
                    android:scheme="https"
                    android:host="links.example.com"
                    android:pathPrefix="/app" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>

        <!--
            All other activities remain exported="false" unless they are
            legitimate entry points (e.g., launcher). No other activity
            accepts VIEW intents.
        -->
    </application>
</manifest>
```

The manifest declares only the routing entry point; all URL parsing, hostname allowlisting, and typed parameter validation occur in `DeepLinkResolverActivity` before any navigation. No identity, role, or entitlement data is accepted from link parameters.
